select id::text as id, tenant_id, pw, role from users where lower(email) = #{email}
mapper.insert: insert into sessions (id, user_id, tenant_id, expires_at) values (#{id}, cast(#{uid} as uuid), #{tid}, now() + make_interval(hours => #{hours}))

mapper.update: update sessions set expires_at = least(created_at + make_interval(days => #{days}), now() + make_interval(hours => #{idleH})) where id = #{sid}
